        c.*,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY homefirm, homezip, substr(beginday, 4, 7)
        ) AS monthly_volume
    FROM cases c
),
december_cases AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN monthly_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN monthly_volume BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS volume_band
    FROM case_volumes
    WHERE substr(beginday, 4, 7) = '12/2023'
),
matching_rules AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        (
            (r.visa_class <> '*')::int
            + (r.wage_level <> '*')::int
            + (r.h1b_dependent <> '*')::int
            + (r.soc_major_group <> '*')::int
            + (r.worksite_state <> '*')::int
            + (r.monthly_volume_band <> '*')::int
        ) AS specificity
    FROM december_cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack

),
selected_rules AS (

           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY filekey
               ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id

matched AS (

        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,

        row_number() OVER (

WITH january_cases AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.h1bdep::VARCHAR AS dependency,

        LEFT(c.soccd, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
        c.headct,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.homefirm, c.homezip) AS monthly_volume
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw

    JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw

    WHERE TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-02-01'
),
case_hours AS (
    SELECT
        j.filekey,
        j.dependency,
        COALESCE(SUM(r.base_hours + r.position_hours * j.headct), 0) AS review_hours
    FROM january_cases AS j
    LEFT JOIN review_schedule AS r
        ON (r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = j.visa_class)
       AND (r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = j.wage_level)
       AND (r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = j.dependency)
       AND (r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = j.soc_major_group)
       AND (r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = j.worksite_state)

           r.monthly_volume_band = '*'

               WHEN j.monthly_volume = 1 THEN '1'
               WHEN j.monthly_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
               WHEN j.monthly_volume BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'

WITH wages AS (

            * CASE p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit'

                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
              END AS aow,
        CAST(regexp_replace(p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS DECIMAL(18,2))
            * CASE p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
              END AS apw,
        p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level
    FROM cases c

    JOIN prevailing_wage p ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack

            WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100

SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(wa.cwas * wa.headct) / CAST(SUM(wa.headct) AS DOUBLE),
    2
) AS employer_wage_assurance_score
FROM (
    SELECT
        b.homefirm,
        b.headct,
        b.start_month,
        0.7 * (
            100 * LEAST(GREATEST((b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40
        )
        + 0.3 * (
            CASE b.wage_level
                WHEN 'I' THEN 25
                WHEN 'II' THEN 50
                WHEN 'III' THEN 75
                WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
                ELSE 50
            END
        ) AS cwas
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.homefirm,
            c.headct,
            date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))::DATE AS start_month,
            pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level,
            CAST(
                replace(replace(pw.wage_details->>'$.offered_wage.from', '$', ''), ',', '')
                AS DOUBLE
            ) * CASE pw.wage_details->>'$.offered_wage.unit'
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END AS aow,
            CAST(
                replace(replace(pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')
                AS DOUBLE
            ) * CASE pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.unit'
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END AS apw
        FROM main.cases c

        LEFT JOIN main.employer e

) wa

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(rv.crh) FILTER (WHERE rv.h1b_dependent = 'Yes')
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.h1b_dependent = 'Yes'), 0),
        2
    ) AS avg_yes,
    ROUND(
        SUM(rv.crh) FILTER (WHERE rv.h1b_dependent = 'No')

        2
    ) AS avg_no
FROM (
    SELECT
        cvb.filekey,

        cvb.visa_class,
        cvb.wage_level,
        cvb.h1b_dependent,
        cvb.soc_major_group,
        cvb.worksite_state,
        cvb.emcv,
        cvb.volume_band,
        r.rule_id AS governing_rule_id,
        COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
        COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours,
        COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50)
            + COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) * cvb.headct AS crh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cv.*,
            CASE
                WHEN cv.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
                WHEN cv.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
                WHEN cv.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
                WHEN cv.emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
            END AS volume_band
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cb.*,
                COUNT(*) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cb.homefirm, cb.start_month
                ) AS emcv
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    c.filekey,
                    c.homefirm,
                    c.headct,
                    CAST(c.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
                    CAST(c.h1bdep AS VARCHAR) AS h1b_dependent,
                    LEFT(c.soccd, 2) AS soc_major_group,
                    DATE_TRUNC(
                        'month',
                        STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')
                    )::DATE AS start_month,
                    cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
                    pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level
                FROM main.cases c
                LEFT JOIN main.case_worksite cw
                    ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
                LEFT JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw
                    ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
            ) cb
        ) cv
    ) cvb
    LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
        ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = cvb.visa_class)
       AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = cvb.wage_level)

       AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = cvb.worksite_state)
       AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = cvb.volume_band)
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY cvb.filekey
        ORDER BY
            (
                CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

) rv

Using the average offered wage as a percentage of the prevailing wage, Google LLC’s June 2024 **Employer Wage Assurance Score is 118.78**. The database does not define official Wage Assurance Tier cutoffs, so the tier below uses an explicit **10–20% above prevailing wage** band.

```sql
WITH wages AS (
    SELECT
        c.homefirm,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_replace(
                pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from',
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS offered_wage,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_replace(
                pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value',
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS prevailing_wage
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Google LLC'
      AND strftime(strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'), '%Y-%m') = '2024-06'
),
score AS (
    SELECT AVG(offered_wage / NULLIF(prevailing_wage, 0)) * 100 AS value
    FROM wages
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN value < 100 THEN 'Below Prevailing Wage'
        WHEN value < 110 THEN '0–10% Above Prevailing Wage'
        WHEN value < 120 THEN '10–20% Above Prevailing Wage'
        ELSE '20%+ Above Prevailing Wage'
    END AS tier_name,
    ROUND(value, 2) AS employer_wage_assurance_score
FROM score;
```

```sql
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
```
```sql
              END AS annual_prevailing,
```
```sql
        CASE p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level'
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25
            WHEN 'II' THEN 50
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75
            WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
            ELSE 50
        END AS level_points
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage p ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        headct,
        level_points,
        100.0 * LEAST(
            GREATEST((annual_offer - annual_prevailing) / annual_prevailing, 0),
            0.40
        ) / 0.40 AS headroom_points
    FROM case_wages
)
SELECT ROUND(
    (
        SUM(headct * (0.6 * headroom_points + 0.4 * level_points))
        - SUM(headct * (0.7 * headroom_points + 0.3 * level_points))
    ) / SUM(headct),
    2
) AS score_change
FROM scored;
```

```sql
WITH case_wages AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        CAST(c.h1bdep AS VARCHAR) AS dependency_status,
        CAST(
            regexp_replace(
                p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from',
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS offered_wage,
        CAST(
            regexp_replace(
                p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value',
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS prevailing_wage,
        p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' AS offered_unit,
        p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' AS prevailing_unit
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage p ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-02-01'
      AND CAST(c.h1bdep AS VARCHAR) IN ('Yes', 'No')
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        dependency_status,
        100.0
        * offered_wage
        * CASE offered_unit
            WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
            WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
            WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
          END
        / NULLIF(
            prevailing_wage
            * CASE prevailing_unit
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
```

```sql
        COUNT(*) OVER (
```
```sql
            PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(r.revdate AS DATE))
        ) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    LEFT JOIN financial_management f ON f.casetag = r.casenum
    WHERE c.profilenum = 'CUS00058'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cr.casenum,
        cr.unit_value,
        cr.actual_charge,
        rule.flat_charge,
        rule.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cr.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    (rule.customer_segment <> 'ANY')::INT
                  + (rule.return_channel <> 'ANY')::INT
                  + (rule.item_category <> 'ANY')::INT
                  + (rule.primary_reason <> 'ANY')::INT
                  + (rule.item_condition <> 'ANY')::INT
                ) DESC NULLS LAST,
                rule.rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM customer_returns cr
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules rule
        ON (rule.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR rule.customer_segment = cr.seg_category)
       AND (rule.return_channel = 'ANY' OR rule.return_channel = cr.return_channel)
       AND (rule.item_category = 'ANY' OR rule.item_category = cr.itemcategory)
       AND (rule.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR rule.primary_reason = cr.primary_reason)

),

)

FROM charges
```

```sql
WITH feb_returns AS (
    SELECT
        o.buyerlink AS customer_id,
        r.casenum,
        p.unit_value,
        c.seg_category,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        r.return_details->'reasoning'->>'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        q.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.buyerlink) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE r.revdate >= '2025-02-01'
      AND r.revdate < '2025-03-01'
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        b.customer_id,
        b.casenum,
        b.unit_value,
        COALESCE(rr.flat_charge, 0)
          + b.unit_value * COALESCE(rr.charge_pct, 0) / 100 AS handling_charge,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    (rr.customer_segment <> 'ANY')::INTEGER
                  + (rr.return_channel <> 'ANY')::INTEGER
                  + (rr.item_category <> 'ANY')::INTEGER
                  + (rr.primary_reason <> 'ANY')::INTEGER
                  + (rr.item_condition <> 'ANY')::INTEGER
                  + (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                  + (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                ) DESC NULLS LAST,
                rr.rule_id
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM feb_returns b
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR rr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
     AND (rr.return_channel = 'ANY' OR rr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category = 'ANY' OR rr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
     AND (rr.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR rr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
     AND (rr.item_condition = 'ANY' OR rr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
     AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL
          OR b.monthly_returns >= rr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL
          OR b.monthly_returns <= rr.max_monthly_returns)
),
customer_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        (SUM(unit_value) - SUM(handling_charge))
            / NULLIF(SUM(unit_value), 0) AS clr_raw
    FROM ranked_rules
    WHERE rule_rank = 1
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT customer_id, ROUND(clr_raw, 2) AS clr
FROM customer_ratios
ORDER BY clr_raw DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 5;
```

Using **Customer Leakage Ratio** as the share of applicable rule-based handling charges not collected, with recorded restocking fees treated as collected charges:

```sql
WITH customer_returns AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS month,
        c.seg_category,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        p.unit_value,
        r.return_details->'reasoning'->>'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        q.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        COALESCE(
            (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::DOUBLE,
            0
        ) AS collected_charge,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.profilenum, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
        ) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    LEFT JOIN financial_management f ON f.casetag = r.casenum
    WHERE c.profilenum = 'CUS00107'
      AND r.revdate >= '2025-01-01'
      AND r.revdate < '2026-01-01'
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        cr.month,
        cr.collected_charge,
        COALESCE(rr.flat_charge, 0)
          + COALESCE(rr.charge_pct, 0) * cr.unit_value / 100
            AS expected_charge,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cr.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN rr.customer_segment = cr.seg_category THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rr.return_channel = cr.return_channel THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rr.item_category = cr.itemcategory THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rr.primary_reason = cr.primary_reason THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rr.item_condition = cr.item_condition THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                (
                    CASE WHEN rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                rr.rule_id
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM customer_returns cr
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = 'ANY'
          OR rr.customer_segment = cr.seg_category)
     AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = 'ANY'
          OR rr.return_channel = cr.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = 'ANY'
          OR rr.item_category = cr.itemcategory)
     AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = 'ANY'
          OR rr.primary_reason = cr.primary_reason)
     AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = 'ANY'
          OR rr.item_condition = cr.item_condition)
     AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL
          OR cr.monthly_returns >= rr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL
          OR cr.monthly_returns <= rr.max_monthly_returns)
)
SELECT
    month,
    ROUND(
        SUM(GREATEST(expected_charge - collected_charge, 0))
        / NULLIF(SUM(expected_charge), 0),
        2
    ) AS clr
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rule_rank = 1
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
```

```sql
WITH snapshots AS (

    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
),
july AS (

        CASE
            WHEN cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS capacity_band,
        CASE
            WHEN monthly_count = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN monthly_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS volume_tier
    FROM snapshots
    WHERE makertag = 'Canadian Solar'
      AND snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2019-07-01'
      AND snapts < TIMESTAMP '2019-08-01'
)

    SUM(COALESCE(w.fixed_fee_usd + j.replcost * w.cover_pct / 100.0, 0)),
    2
) AS settlement_usd

    SELECT fixed_fee_usd, cover_pct
    FROM warranty_settle_rules w
    WHERE w.maker_tag IN ('ALL', j.makertag)
      AND w.pnl_kind IN ('ALL', j.pnlkind)
      AND (w.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR w.alrt_state = j.alrtstate)

        + (w.pnl_kind <> 'ALL')::INT
        + (w.alrt_state <> 'ALL')::INT
        + (w.warr_state <> 'ALL')::INT
        + (w.cap_band <> 'ALL')::INT
        + (w.vol_tier <> 'ALL')::INT DESC,
        w.rule_id
    LIMIT 1
) w ON TRUE;
```

```sql
        c.seg_category,
        CAST(p.unit_value AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS item_value,
        CAST(qa.assessment_summary->'results'->>'aesthetic_score' AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS aesthetic_score,
        qa.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'completeness' AS completeness,
        CAST(r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS shipping_fee
    FROM returns AS r
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products AS p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    JOIN quality_assessment AS qa ON qa.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE r.revdate >= '2025-01-01'
      AND r.revdate < '2026-01-01'
      AND c.seg_category IN ('Retail', 'Wholesale')
)
SELECT
    seg_category,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            item_value
            - item_value * aesthetic_score / 10
              * CASE completeness
                    WHEN 'Complete' THEN 1.00
                    WHEN 'Accessories Missing' THEN 0.85
                    WHEN 'Missing Parts' THEN 0.60
                END
            + shipping_fee
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(item_value), 0),
        2
    ) AS clr
FROM per_return
GROUP BY seg_category
ORDER BY seg_category;
```

```sql
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey

        CASE
```
```sql
            WHEN claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'

            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
```
```sql
    FROM base b
),
```
```sql
matches AS (
    SELECT
        b.snapkey,
        b.sitekey,
        b.snapts,
        b.replcost,
        w.rule_id,
        w.fixed_fee_usd,
        w.cover_pct,
        (
            CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
            CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
            CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
            CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
            CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
            CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        ) AS specificity
    FROM tiered b
    LEFT JOIN warranty_settle_rules w
        ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR w.maker_tag = b.makertag)

        PARTITION BY snapkey

)

            + COALESCE(cover_pct, 5.00) / 100.0
```

```sql
 FROM (
```
```sql
   SELECT r.snapkey, r.snapts, m.makertag, m.pnlkind, a.alrtstate, p.warrstate, o.replcost,

   FROM main.plant_record r
```

WITH st AS (
```sql
 SELECT s.snapkey, s.snapts, s.vol_tier, s.replcost, w.fixed_fee_usd, w.cover_pct,
   (CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS spec
 FROM (
   SELECT r.snapkey, r.snapts, m.makertag, m.pnlkind, a.alrtstate, p.warrstate, o.replcost,
     COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'), date_trunc('month', r.snapts)) AS claim_volume,
     CASE WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small' WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid' WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large' END AS cap_band,
     CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'), date_trunc('month', r.snapts)) = 1 THEN 'Single'
          WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'), date_trunc('month', r.snapts)) <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
          ELSE 'Bulk' END AS vol_tier
   FROM main.plant_record r
   LEFT JOIN main.plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
   LEFT JOIN main.panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook
   LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
   LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
 ) s
 LEFT JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
   ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR w.maker_tag = s.makertag)
  AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR w.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
  AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR w.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)

  AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR w.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.snapkey ORDER BY spec DESC, w.rule_id ASC) = 1
)
```

```sql
        ) AS month_volume
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie

    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = pr.snapkey

            WHEN month_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'

          + COALESCE(r.cover_pct, 5.0) / 100.0

    FROM classified c

              + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL AND r.vol_tier <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

            r.rule_id ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) r ON TRUE
)
```

Claim volume is calculated by manufacturer and calendar month before restricting the results to 2021.

```sql
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    r.snapkey,
    r.snapts,
    m.makertag,
    m.pnlkind,
    a.alrtstate,
    p.warrstate,
    o.replcost,
    CASE
      WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
      WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
      WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
    END AS cap_band,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'),
                   DATE_TRUNC('month', r.snapts)
    ) AS claim_volume
  FROM plant_record r
  LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
  LEFT JOIN panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook
  LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
  LEFT JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT
    base.*,
    CASE
      WHEN claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
      WHEN claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
      ELSE 'Bulk'
    END AS vol_tier
  FROM base
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT
    s.snapkey,
    s.snapts,
    s.vol_tier,
    s.replcost,
    w.rule_id,
    w.fixed_fee_usd,
    w.cover_pct,
    (
      CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    ) AS specificity
  FROM tiered s
  LEFT JOIN warranty_settle_rules w
    ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR w.maker_tag = s.makertag)
   AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR w.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
   AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR w.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)
   AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = 'ALL' OR w.warr_state = s.warrstate)
   AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = 'ALL' OR w.cap_band = s.cap_band)
   AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR w.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
),
settled AS (
  SELECT
    snapkey, snapts, vol_tier, replcost,
    fixed_fee_usd, cover_pct
  FROM eligible
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY snapkey
    ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
  ) = 1
)
SELECT
  vol_tier,
  COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      COALESCE(fixed_fee_usd, 300.00)
      + COALESCE(cover_pct, 5.00) / 100.0
        * COALESCE(CAST(replcost AS DOUBLE), 0)
    ),
    2
  ) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM settled
WHERE snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
  AND snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
  AND vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
GROUP BY vol_tier
ORDER BY vol_tier;
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_yield AS (
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_energy AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', r.snapts) AS month_start,

),
technology_months AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        technology,
        SUM(energy_kwh * soil_loss_pct / 100.0) AS recoverable_energy_kwh,
        SUM(energy_kwh * soil_loss_pct) / NULLIF(SUM(energy_kwh), 0) AS energy_loss_pct
```

```sql
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        strftime(r.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS month_key,
        SUM(
            TRY_CAST(
                e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w'
                AS DOUBLE
            )
        ) AS loss_w,
        SUM(m.rated_w) AS rated_w
    FROM plant_record AS r
    JOIN plants AS p
        ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
    JOIN plant_panel_model AS ppm
        ON ppm.sitelink = p.sitekey
    JOIN panel_models AS m
        ON m.modkey = ppm.modlink
    JOIN electrical_performance AS e
        ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
    WHERE m.pnlkind = 'HJT'
      AND r.snapts >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND r.snapts < DATE '2023-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT
        month_key,
        100.0 * loss_w / NULLIF(rated_w, 0) AS ratio
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT
    month_key AS "month",
    ROUND(ratio, 2) AS loss_ratio_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN ratio < 5 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN ratio < 10 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS loss_band
FROM ratios
ORDER BY month_key;
```

```sql
WITH snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        r.snapkey,
        date_trunc('month', r.snapts) AS snapshot_month,
        pm.pnlkind AS technology,
        TRY_CAST(
            e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh'
            AS DOUBLE
        ) AS energy_yield_kwh,
        TRY_CAST(
            e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct'
            AS DOUBLE
        ) AS soil_loss_pct
    FROM plant_record r
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
    WHERE r.snapts >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND r.snapts < DATE '2022-01-01'
),
technology_months AS (
    SELECT
        technology,
        snapshot_month,
        CASE
            WHEN AVG(soil_loss_pct) >= 10 THEN 'Severe'
            WHEN AVG(soil_loss_pct) < 5 THEN 'Low'
            ELSE 'Moderate'
        END AS loss_band
    FROM snapshots
    GROUP BY technology, snapshot_month
)
SELECT
    t.loss_band,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            s.energy_yield_kwh * s.soil_loss_pct
            / NULLIF(100 - s.soil_loss_pct, 0)

JOIN technology_months t
  ON t.technology = s.technology
 AND t.snapshot_month = s.snapshot_month
WHERE t.loss_band IN ('Severe', 'Low')
```

        r.snapkey,
```sql
        pm.pnlkind,
        date_trunc('month', r.snapts) AS snap_month,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh') AS DOUBLE) AS energy,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.availability_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS availability,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.efficiency.soil_loss_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS soil
    FROM plant_record r
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
    WHERE r.snapts >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND r.snapts < DATE '2022-01-01'
),
losses AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        energy / (
            (CASE WHEN availability <= 1 THEN availability ELSE availability / 100.0 END)
            * (1.0 - soil / 100.0)
        ) AS potential
    FROM readings
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snap_month,
        100.0 * SUM(potential - energy) / SUM(potential) AS loss_ratio
    FROM losses
    GROUP BY pnlkind, snap_month
),
labeled AS (
    SELECT
        l.*,
        CASE
            WHEN m.loss_ratio < 6 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN m.loss_ratio >= 14 THEN 'Severe'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS loss_band
    FROM losses l
    JOIN monthly m USING (pnlkind, snap_month)
)
SELECT
    loss_band,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(potential - energy), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM labeled
WHERE loss_band IN ('Severe', 'Low')
GROUP BY loss_band
ORDER BY CASE loss_band WHEN 'Severe' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;
```
